subject: Upcoming Company Event: Annual Employee Appreciation Dinner
body: Dear Team, We are excited to announce that the Annual Employee Appreciation Dinner is scheduled for next Friday at the Grand Ballroom. Please mark your calendars and make sure to RSVP by the end of this week. It will be a wonderful evening filled with great food, entertainment, and recognition of our hardworking employees. We look forward to celebrating together! Best regards, [Company Name] HR Team
